name: code-review
description: Pull-request reviewer agents for Qida apps (review a PR, a branch or a whole directory; terminal report, optional PR comments with --comment): deterministic magic-string detection for TypeScript/JavaScript (inline domain values, inline query keys per ADR-FE-002, literal UI text per ADR-FE-004, hardcoded secrets) TypeScript conventions for new code (no any or classes per ADR-FE-001, no enums, named exports, import type, plus advisory style rules) and Zod validation (safeParse, never parse)
